notes.subject: i no skrusim moa
notes.rationale: מעיר (rong עור 'skruksim/wokim ap'): sumba i tok 'stir the fire' (asv), narapela 'stir/knead the dough' (jps, kjv margin)

notes.subject: pasin bilong ran wantaim meri bilong narapela man
notes.rationale: מנאפים i min ol i brukim marit — pasin bilong Hebru 'adultery' i gat min bilong lotu tu: ol i lus fes long Yahwe

translation: Olgeta bilong ol i gat pasin bilong ran wantaim meri bilong narapela man, olsem ovin bilong paia i burin, bilong man i kukim bret; em i malolo, i no skrusim moa, stat long mitim mitimit bilong flaua i go inap em i kamap swel.

tokens.gloss: i gat pasin bilong ran wantaim meri bilong narapela
